rejected_facts.reason: The cited dataclass declaration supports a boolean done field and an optional string due field, but it does not itself establish that every Task due value is a validated ISO calendar date; Task can be constructed directly without validation.

The tests support ordering by completion, priority, due date, and placing undated tasks last, but neither cited test creates an otherwise tied pair whose order is determined by id. Therefore the claim that these tests lock deterministic id ordering is unsupported.

audit_summary: Reopened all cited files. Their SHA-256 hashes and repository HEAD match the supplied snapshot. Fourteen facts are directly supported; F1 and F9 contain unsupported overclaims. No conflicts were reported, so none required disposition.
